claims.text: The hotel sits on a secluded stretch of the Riviera Maya coastline, about 45 minutes south of Cancun International Airport and just outside Playa del Carmen.

findings.quote: On a secluded stretch of the Riviera Maya coastline, about 45 minutes south of Cancún International Airport and just outside Playa del Carmen

claims.text: Architect David Quintana filled the property with handcrafted works by Mexican artisans, native materials and contemporary design rooted in its surroundings.

findings.quote: He entrusted that vision to his son, architect David Quintana, who filled the property with handcrafted works by Mexican artisans, native materials, and contemporary design rooted in its surroundings.

claims.text: The suites are adorned with artwork and handcrafted pieces created by Mexican artisans, and they look out on views of nature.

findings.quote: La Casa de la Playa features 63 suites designed to captivate you with breathtaking views of nature, adorned with artwork and handcrafted pieces created by Mexican artisans.

claims.text: Suite benefits include butler service.

findings.quote: Butler service

claims.text: Suite benefits include a volcanic stone bathtub.

findings.quote: Beach Front Suite
Ocean view and direct access to beach

claims.text: The Master Suites have a spacious design and panoramic ocean views.

findings.quote: The Master Suites stand out for their spacious design, panoramic ocean views, and serene details.

claims.text: Muluk Spa uses organic products.

findings.quote: We use organic products that care for both your skin and the environment.

Chef Martha Ortiz celebrates Mexican cuisine with a talented all-female team.

claims.text: Xal, by chef Andoni Luis Aduriz, is inspired by the Manila Route, which connected Mexico, Asia and Europe for more than 250 years.

findings.quote: Chef Andoni Luis Aduriz
The culinary syncretism of Mexico unfolds in a disruptive proposal at Xal, a culinary concept inspired by the Manila Route, which connected Mexico, Asia, and Europe for more than 250 years.

drifting weightlessly through the built-in aquarium in the wall beside the bed.

claims.text: A rooftop infinity pool looks out over the Caribbean, and a lower glass-walled infinity pool projects over the sea.

findings.quote: the rooftop infinity pool offers uninterrupted Caribbean views, while the other, lower glass-walled infinity pool projects over the sea

claims.text: Each suite's outdoor space has a large plunge pool, a hammock, an oversized daybed and a soaking tub where butlers prepare custom baths with honey- or mint-infused products.

findings.quote: The outdoor space offers a large plunge pool, hammock, oversized daybed, and soaking tub where butlers prepare custom baths with your choice of honey- or mint-infused products.

claims.text: The shoreline is made up of rocky outcroppings rather than a long walkable beach, so the pools and the views are the focal point.

findings.quote: don’t come expecting a long, walkable beach. Instead, the shoreline is made up of rocky outcroppings, making the pools—and the views—the true focal point.

claims.text: Muluk Spa is relatively compact.

findings.quote: Muluk Spa is relatively compact with serene treatment rooms illuminated by flickering candle-like lights.
